items.title_zh: 从买日元到增加美债回购，贝森特成数十年来最积极干预市场的美国财长
items.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is staking his credibility on capping the rise in Treasury yields through a series of unexpected market operations, making him the most actively interventionist Treasury secretary in decades.
items.summary_zh: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特（Scott Bessent）正以一系列出人意料的市场操作，将自身信誉押注于压制美债收益率上行这一目标，成为数十年来对金融市场干预最为积极的财政部长

items.title: Trump says Iran's economy is collapsing. A former central bank adviser in Tehran pushes back

items.summary: Iran's economy is deteriorating under mounting sanctions, but far from unraveling, a former adviser to Iran's central bank told CNBC.
items.summary_zh: 一位伊朗央行前顾问告诉 CNBC，在日益增长制裁的重压下，伊朗经济正在恶化，但远未崩溃

items.summary_zh: 周四，在美方就针对伊朗经济施压表态后，油价走高
